severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — PANORAMIC INTEGRITY ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: SYNTHETIC-WILDERNESS FRONT ROLLS ACROSS SCENIC REGIONS AS AI-GENERATED 'NATURE SLOP' FLOODS FEEDS WITH IMPOSSIBLE MOUNTAINS, GLOWING FORESTS, AND MAJESTIC ANIMALS THAT POSSESS TOO MANY LEGS, NO KNOWN RANGE, AND AN UNEARNED SENSE OF WONDER
advisory: The National Slop Service is tracking a dense panoramic system depositing AI-generated landscape and wildlife imagery across all scenic viewing areas. Residents are advised that a 'breathtaking Norwegian fjord at golden hour' may feature water flowing uphill, a sun casting four shadows, and a stag whose antlers fork into their own reflection. These images are engineered to trigger awe at scale; awe, we remind the public, is not the same as accuracy. Verify before you share, and do not attempt to visit anything you cannot locate on a map.

regional_outlook.conditions: Saturated with iridescent 'enchanted woodlands' and bioluminescent waterfalls. Visibility reduced by a persistent haze of unnatural teal.
Heavy drift of captioned 'God's beautiful creation' posts depicting fox-wolf hybrids. Engagement bait expected to accumulate in the comments by evening.
Looping flyovers of mountain ranges that rearrange themselves between frames. Ambient flute track unavoidable.
Travel wallpaper downloads increasingly indistinguishable from fever dreams. Reverse-image searches returning only more slop.
Nature photography coffee-table e-books rising rapidly, none of whose landscapes exist. Cover of 'Majestic Earth: 100 Real Places' flagged for irony.

specimen.status: Abundant; peaks seasonally with every 'most beautiful places' listicle
specimen.habitat: Wallpaper galleries, inspirational feeds, stock-image bins, and the desktop backgrounds of residents who should have known better
specimen.field_marks: Lighting that arrives from three directions at once; mountains both snowcapped and tropical; a waterfall that empties into itself; one animal in the foreground with an extra joint and a gaze of counterfeit serenity. Colors tuned past the limits of any atmosphere Earth has ever possessed.
specimen.call: Nature is healing — tag someone who needs to see this absolutely real place
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for genuine landscape photography. Telltale difference: a real photograph has a location, a photographer, and a reason the shadows agree with each other. The Impossible Vista has only vibes.data.gov coordinates that resolve to the open ocean.

spotter_tip: Trace the sunlight. If a single scene is lit from the left, the right, and below simultaneously, you are not looking at a sunset — you are looking at a rendering engine that has never been outdoors.
tomorrow: Synthetic-wilderness front persists; scattered impossible fjords clearing to a thin fog of fake aurora overnight.

confirmed_sighting.report: Art-world observers have documented the rise of 'nature slop,' a genre of low-quality AI-generated art depicting wildlife and landscapes now proliferating across online feeds. The Service notes this confirms what our instruments have logged all week: the scenery is spreading faster than the places it claims to depict.
